payload.unusable_reason: Not a claim for one [name]: a suo motu writ petition on [name] awarded by MACTs and [name] [name] but never collected. The Supreme Court issued procedural directions and decided no amount.

precedent.holding: Until state rules are framed, MACTs granting [name] must make the persons entitled produce their bank account details (banker's certificate or cancelled cheque) and, in the ordinary course, transfer the [name] directly to those accounts. Claim petitions must give claimants' names, addresses, Aadhaar and PAN details; [name] [name] go into auto-renewing fixed deposits.

extraction.title_anon: Supreme Court directions on unclaimed MACT [name], all India (no award)
extraction.family_summary: This was not one family's case. In 2024 the Supreme Court took up, on its own, the problem of [name] that [name] had awarded but claimants never collected, which in some states ran to hundreds of crores of rupees. On 22 April 2025 it awarded no money, but told [name] across India to take claimants' bank details and pay awards straight into their accounts. It also ordered a drive, [name] the help of legal services authorities, to trace people who have not collected their [name].
what_mattered: No amount was decided: the case was about [name] already awarded but never collected, so it gives no award to compare [name].

[name] must now take the bank details (banker's certificate or cancelled cheque) of the people entitled to [name] and, in the ordinary course, pay straight into those accounts; claimants must keep those details up to date.
